inclusion_rule: include every FT2-20 finding whose original anchor names FT2-10 and every FT2-08 repair-crosswalk entry whose owner array names FT2-10

findings.title: Primary entry test is not the required one-account serial game
findings.original_anchor: joined_review.md lines 117-125; FT2-10 objective_spec and FT2-11 evidence
findings.ft2_10_repair: objective_spec.json freezes the universal serial minute grid, occupied/pending treatment, WAIT accounting, policy-specific integer-cent ledgers, t+1 fill resolution, D48/D49/soft-close state, neutral hold-to-15:55 lifecycle, re-entry law, and exact P5-under-cap comparator.
findings.acceptance_contract: candidate and comparator each mutate only their own causal ledger; impossible occupied BUYs are never scored; all universal-grid states remain in denominators.
findings.remaining_owner: FT2-11 freezes clustered inference and all-required pass criteria on this population.

findings.title: Composer can structurally delete the Charter big-win column
findings.original_anchor: joined_review.md lines 127-135; FT2-10 composer and FT2-11 tripwire
findings.ft2_10_repair: composer_spec.json adds mandatory alpha=0.0 no-screen control to every campaign; objective_spec.json freezes per-session big-win incidence, tail opportunity dollars, positive serial-PnL concentration, relative ratios, zero-denominator handling, and owner-decision routing.
findings.acceptance_contract: every serious candidate, fold, seed, ensemble, and $3/$4 path retains the no-screen arm; tail metrics cannot enter optimization.
findings.remaining_owner: FT2-11 freezes clustered intervals, material-capture thresholds, multiplicity, and terminal precedence.

findings.title: Dual-unit min arbitration biases middle-premium contracts
findings.original_anchor: joined_review.md lines 137-143; FT2-10 composer_spec and objective_spec
findings.ft2_10_repair: objective_spec.json defines session-balanced empirical CDFs per metric, horizon, unit, census-v2 premium band, and phase; composer_spec.json compares dollar and return ranks only inside the same causal decision-time premium band.
findings.acceptance_contract: exact band boundaries, population, session/row weights, midrank ties, linear interpolation, nesting, same-band-only fallback, and fail-closed insufficiency are frozen.
findings.remaining_owner: FT2-30 implements synthetic fixtures; FT2-31 independently accepts machinery.

findings.title: Exact-contract uncertainty can deadlock valid directional sessions
findings.ft2_10_repair: composer_spec.json freezes a same-expiry, same-right, plus/minus-one-strike cluster and compares selected-cluster score with the best outside cluster or WAIT rather than an adjacent exact-contract substitute.
findings.acceptance_contract: cluster-gap model and source residuals use the same definition; exact-contract quality is separately covered by the regret head.
findings.remaining_owner: FT2-11 freezes the statistical calibration pass rule.

findings.title: Future target_valid directly controls the composer
findings.original_anchor: joined_review.md lines 205-213; FT2-10 composer_spec and FT2-08 label_join_spec
findings.ft2_10_repair: composer_spec.json derives finite-horizon availability only from e=t+1, the 15:55 clock boundary, family registration, and finite model outputs; target_valid, label-derived forecast_valid, label_join_present, future bid availability, and censoring are forbidden.
findings.acceptance_contract: stripping every label partition and label-derived mask must leave horizons, scores, actions, WAIT reasons, and tie traces bit-identical.
findings.remaining_owner: FT2-30/31 implement and independently verify the invariant.

findings.title: Census consumes the first fold embargo session
findings.original_anchor: joined_review.md lines 215-221; FT2-10 calibration/composer plus FT2-08 fold_roles
findings.ft2_10_repair: all composer, calibration, contract, and receipt census citations point to the repaired 45-session v2 packet and its hashes; the five fold embargo sessions have zero intersection.
findings.acceptance_contract: v1 guardrail, excluded-winner, trade-rate, friction, and census hashes or values are forbidden as current FT2-10 authority.

findings.title: DeltaQ replaces signed incremental-profit evidence

findings.ft2_10_repair: objective_spec.json demotes DeltaQ to diagnostic/inner-loop use and requires quality evidence, all safety gates, and no harm versus exact P5 in neutral-lifecycle serial dollars under separate $3/$4 causal ledgers.
findings.acceptance_contract: entry can earn only a component freeze; promotable dollar claims are deferred to combined FT2-80 evaluation.
findings.remaining_owner: FT2-11 freezes serial-dollar noninferiority margin, adjusted interval, multiplicity, and terminal rule.

findings.title: Mandatory action-conditioned calibration gate is absent

findings.ft2_10_repair: forecast_heads.json adds a WAIT-probability head plus expected-regret and q90-regret heads, exact losses, realized targets, training data path, and conformal upper-bound derivation; calibration_spec.json makes the gate non-skippable.

findings.title: Empirical-CDF metric is under-specified and not nested
findings.ft2_10_repair: objective_spec.json freezes the exact reference population, metric/horizon/unit/band/phase scope, equal-session weighting, row weights, midrank tie knots, interpolation, endpoints, minimums, same-band fallback, canonical hash, and inner/final nesting.
findings.acceptance_contract: the scored block, chronological future, disjoint final calibration, and outer validation never enter their own CDF; no transduction is permitted.
findings.remaining_owner: FT2-30/31 implementation and independent fixture acceptance

findings.title: OOF conformal residuals are reused for a different refit
findings.ft2_10_repair: calibration_spec.json reserves a chronological disjoint final-calibration set, fits the final model once on earlier sessions separated by an embargo, calibrates that same model, and forbids every post-calibration refit.
findings.acceptance_contract: earlier-block residuals cannot calibrate the final model; all final model/calibration identities and hashes freeze before outer validation.

findings.title: Multiplicity omits selectable control attempts
findings.original_anchor: joined_review.md lines 308-323; FT2-11 multiplicity and FT2-10 controls
findings.ft2_10_repair: controls_spec.json freezes eight SHA-256-ranked matched-random schedules, eight shuffle identities, no redraw, no best-seed selection, exact pre-outcome schedule construction, post-replay matching, and incomplete-attempt handling.
findings.acceptance_contract: all attempted identities and selectable admitted-channel sets enter the ordered ledger; any invalid random schedule yields insufficient control with no replacement.
findings.remaining_owner: FT2-11 includes all attempts, aggregates, controls, and extension sets in multiplicity and terminal precedence.

findings.acceptance_contract: historical component research may mark transfer unavailable; decision-shadow/live/paper activation remains blocked until candidate-specific transfer passes.
